payload.entry: LAND TRIAGE: Read all notes on phases bob-cli-a0.2.1.7.1, .2, and .3: no PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries. Also read all six parent phase beads and every note. Parent phase bob-cli-a0.2.1.1 note #1 (PDFKit public citation) was re-triaged with /sase_new_task: no duplicate task after same-type and all-type searches and the one-week sweep; corroborated the existing DISCOVERED ISSUE on active outer epic bob-cli-a0, which owns public citation follow-through. Related task bob-cli-8p is a memory decision, not the same remediation; bob-cli-85 is a rendering defect, not a citation duplicate. No task created. Parent phase bob-cli-a0.2.1.4 note #1 (HTTP-only fragment checking) remains DECLINED: its premise is false and its remediation is already part of this epic; offline lychee with --include-fragments --index-files index.html passed 3595 links with zero errors on this audit. The four remaining mount/serve defects found here are caused by this epic and will remain epic work in one medium tale; none is deferred as a task.

LAND AUDIT at master d5c98a2a (fresh git fetch: origin/master identical). Read the epic plan, governing parent plan and inherited decisions, all three child notes and implementation commits 2c50df55/5cbfea1f/d5c98a2a, and all six parent child beads/notes. Verified the frontmatter stamp repair, symlink/stale guards, production checks, assembled-nav/exact-stamp lint, privacy/fence/ratchet fixes, widened scans, URL checks, offline fragments, templates and authoring changes. just docs-check passed: 168 tests, 27 contracts, 32 pages, 365 mentions, one curated URL, two search cases, lychee 3595 links/zero errors; live manifest gave first-publish 404 warning. just docs-build-material passed. git diff --check and tracked-tree status clean; no generated drift. No unrelated commits since this child started. Parent-era unrelated 24f43958 only changes the task-move contract (already registered and passing these gates); MIT license c7df845f agrees with decisions. Rust/check recipe and SASE memory untouched by this child. epic-symbols is empty for this epic, bob-cli-a0.2.1, and bob-cli-a0.2; symvision recipe absent. Remaining reproduced epic defects: (1) discover_repo accepts existing non-Git overrides/siblings and a Git sibling with the wrong origin, since those branches only check is_dir; the requested invalid-existing-source fixtures are absent. (2) Adding !docs/reference/plugins/guide.md after the directory ignore lets assemble write guide.md even though git check-ignore exits 1; only the synthetic probe is checked. (3) After cloning a local fixture remote, asking for branch missing emits offline/keeping cached with fatal: could not find remote ref and succeeds instead of rejecting configuration error. (4) mirror_docs_once permanently fails file-to-directory replacement with FileExistsError and reverse replacement with IsADirectoryError because it copies before deleting type conflicts. These are bounded mount/serve fixes for a medium tale, whose final step must close this epic, revalidate/close bob-cli-a0.2.1, then close phase bob-cli-a0.2 only. just check is still required after those fixes; just check-full was not run.

REMAINING-WORK PLAN: Authored sase_plan_docs_mount_closeout.md as tier tale, size medium, covering only the four reproduced mount/serve defects and their fixtures, then combined docs-check/Material/just check verification and the full same-turn closeout. The final step explicitly closes this epic, marks plan:202610/docs_toolchain_landing_fixes.md done, revalidates and closes parent plan bob-cli-a0.2.1 and marks plan:202610/docs_toolchain.md done, then closes parent phase bob-cli-a0.2 while leaving bob-cli-a0 open. No dependency on this work own commit/push/CI and no force for successful nested landing. Follow-up triage is complete in the preceding note. Initial explained validation identified missing title/goal and inert tale parent_bead; corrected the schema and revalidated successfully.
